moments.title: Love Island UK 2026 Finale
moments.blurb: The 13th season of Love Island UK concludes live tomorrow night, with the remaining couples battling for the £50,000 prize.

angles.name: Who will win?
angles.copy: Tomorrow night, the Love Island UK villa closes its doors for another year! Who are you rooting for to take home the £50k? Tune in at 9 PM on ITV2 and ITVX. #LoveIsland

angles.name: Finale format change
angles.copy: Love Island UK host Maya Jama has teased a 'different format' for tomorrow's grand finale. What twists could be in store for the final couples? Don't miss it!

moments.title: Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games Closing Ceremony
moments.blurb: The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games conclude on August 2nd with a closing ceremony featuring Scottish rock band Simple Minds and Australian singer Delta Goodrem.

angles.name: Final weekend of action
angles.copy: It's the final week of the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games! Who's been your standout star or favourite moment so far? The closing ceremony is August 2nd!

angles.name: Closing ceremony headliners
angles.copy: Simple Minds are set to headline the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games closing ceremony on August 2nd! A fitting end to a fantastic sporting event in Scotland.

moments.title: Mick Jagger turns 83
moments.blurb: The iconic frontman of The Rolling Stones, Mick Jagger, celebrates his 83rd birthday today, July 26th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mick!
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Mick Jagger! Still got the moves, still got the voice. What's your favourite Rolling Stones track?

angles.name: Rock icon
angles.copy: 83 years young and still rocking! Wishing a very happy birthday to The Rolling Stones' incomparable frontman, Mick Jagger. A true icon of rock and roll.

moments.title: Roger Taylor turns 77
moments.blurb: Queen drummer and songwriter Roger Taylor celebrates his 77th birthday today, July 26th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Roger!
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to the one and only Roger Taylor of Queen! 77 today and still drumming up a storm. What's your top Queen song with Roger on vocals?

angles.name: Queen's beat
angles.copy: The powerful beat behind Queen, Roger Taylor, celebrates his 77th birthday today! From 'Radio Ga Ga' to 'A Kind of Magic', his impact is undeniable.

moments.title: Stormzy turns 33
moments.blurb: British grime and hip-hop superstar Stormzy celebrates his 33rd birthday today, July 26th.

angles.name: Big Mike's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 33rd Birthday to the one and only Stormzy! From freestyle king to festival headliner, what's your favourite track from Big Mike?

angles.name: Grime icon
angles.copy: Celebrating 33 years of the legendary Stormzy today! A true pioneer who changed the game for British music. What's your go-to Stormzy anthem?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is the UK's Official Singles Chart Number 1 for an 18th non-consecutive week, matching the longest-running UK Number 1 of all time.

angles.name: Chart record breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is Number 1 for an 18th week, equalling the all-time UK record! Have you streamed it today?

angles.name: Shakira & Burna Boy at No.2
angles.copy: Shakira & Burna Boy's World Cup anthem 'Dai Dai' holds strong at Number 2 in the UK Singles Chart! What a track!

moments.title: Folk festivals kick off this week
moments.blurb: The Cambridge Folk Festival, Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival, and Wickham Festival all begin on Thursday, July 30th.

angles.name: Festival season continues
angles.copy: Calling all folk fans! Cambridge, Belladrum, and Wickham Festivals all kick off this Thursday. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Belladrum for Scotland
angles.copy: Get ready for the Tartan Heart! Belladrum Festival begins this Thursday in the Highlands, bringing a fantastic lineup to Scotland. Who's heading there?

moments.title: AIG Women's Open at Royal Lytham & St Annes
moments.blurb: The AIG Women's Open golf championship begins on Wednesday, July 29th, at Royal Lytham & St Annes in England.

angles.name: Major golf event
angles.copy: The world's best female golfers descend on Royal Lytham & St Annes this Wednesday for the AIG Women's Open! Who's your pick for the title?

angles.name: Lancashire golf
angles.copy: A huge week for golf in the UK! The AIG Women's Open tees off in Lancashire on Wednesday. Get ready for some incredible action.

moments.title: Buddy Guy turns 90
moments.blurb: Legendary blues guitarist and singer Buddy Guy celebrates his 90th birthday on Thursday, July 30th.

angles.name: Blues legend at 90
angles.copy: A very happy 90th birthday to the incredible blues legend Buddy Guy this Thursday! What a career, what a guitarist. Give us your favourite track!

angles.name: Influential guitarist
angles.copy: Celebrating 90 years of the influential bluesman Buddy Guy this week. His impact on music is immeasurable. Turn up the blues for Buddy!

moments.title: Kate Bush turns 68
moments.blurb: Iconic British singer-songwriter Kate Bush celebrates her 68th birthday on Thursday, July 30th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Kate!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to the incomparable Kate Bush this Thursday! What's your most loved Kate Bush song?

angles.name: Wuthering Heights to Running Up That Hill
angles.copy: From 'Wuthering Heights' to 'Running Up That Hill', Kate Bush's unique artistry continues to captivate. Happy 68th to a true legend on Thursday!

moments.title: Joe Elliott turns 67
moments.blurb: Def Leppard frontman Joe Elliott celebrates his 67th birthday on Saturday, August 1st.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Joe!
angles.copy: Rock on! A very happy 67th birthday to Def Leppard's legendary singer, Joe Elliott, this Saturday. What's your favourite Def Leppard anthem?

angles.name: Def Leppard legend
angles.copy: Pour some sugar on him! Celebrating Joe Elliott's 67th birthday this Saturday. The voice of Def Leppard, still sounding incredible.

moments.title: Summer Holidays in full swing
moments.blurb: The school summer holidays are well underway across England and Wales, with many families enjoying their breaks before schools return in early September.

angles.name: Summer break fun
angles.copy: Summer holidays are in full swing for many! What's been your favourite family adventure so far, or what are your plans for the last few weeks?

angles.name: Making memories
angles.copy: Enjoying the Welsh summer holidays? We want to hear about your adventures and days out across South Wales! Making memories before school starts again.
